name: 23315-multiturn-qwq32b-tp2
model: Qwen/QwQ-32B. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE: its chat template inserts message content verbatim (no `| trim`) and its generation prompt ends with an opening `<think>` tag, so every response begins already inside a thinking block.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, bounded by a 900 s window with the first 25% of it discarded as warmup. A stream is an IN-FLIGHT REQUEST, not a session: a session pausing between turns releases its slot, so about twelve sessions are alive at the declared think-time.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, FIVE-TURN conversations over `/v1/chat/completions`, seed 42. Each turn appends a 512 +- 64 token user message (clamped to [384, 640]) to the whole conversation so far and generates exactly 2048 tokens greedily (`temperature: 0.0`, `ignore_eos: true`); between turns the session pauses 25 +- 15 s, clamped to [5, 60], emitted as a per-turn `requeue_delay`. The client is an ordinary OpenAI-convention chat client: it replays the assistant's `content` into history and drops `reasoning_content`. No prefix buckets and no shared system prompt.
purpose: A reasoning assistant holding five-turn conversations with long replies for about a dozen users on two GPUs.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped by the reader, so a nested value would
# silently not reach the engine.

model-path: Qwen/QwQ-32B
tp-size: 2

# `qwen3-thinking`, NOT `qwen3`. Both select the same detector class; `qwen3-thinking` starts it
# already in the reasoning state, which QwQ-32B needs because its template puts `<think>` in the
# PROMPT, so the stream the server classifies never contains an opening tag. Under plain `qwen3`
# the detector calls the response ordinary content and returns the whole thinking stream in
# `content`, which the client replays into the next turn -- a different workload from the
# declared one.
reasoning-parser: qwen3-thinking

max-total-tokens: 81920
context-length: 8192
random-seed: 42
